description: Paid: 0.001 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What is the UTC time according to the NIST Internet Time Service right now? One shared NTP reading of time.nist.gov (refreshed at most every 30 s) with offset, round-trip and stratum shown, plus source and observed_at. NIST describes UTC(NIST) as realized from an ensemble of atomic clocks; this is a network-estimated reading, not NIST-certified or traceable, and not for safety-critical, legal-timestamp or settlement use. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
